questions.cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:HAS_OBSERVATION]->(:Observation {predicate: 'HAS_DEFECT'})-[:OBJECT]->(d:Mention) WHERE any(n IN [d.name] + coalesce(d.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'wobbl') RETURN DISTINCT p.product_name

questions.question: Which products are reported with misaligned pre-drilled holes?
questions.cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:HAS_OBSERVATION]->(o:Observation {predicate: 'HAS_DEFECT'})-[:SUBJECT]->(h:Mention), (o)-[:OBJECT]->(d:Mention) WHERE any(n IN [h.name] + coalesce(h.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'hole') AND any(n IN [d.name] + coalesce(d.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(n) CONTAINS 'align' OR toLower(n) CONTAINS 'line up') RETURN DISTINCT p.product_name

questions.question: Which products are reported to squeak or creak?
